pose: Short, stocky arm bones—much shorter than the hind legs.
visual_hook: Makes the dinosaur look like it is 'sloping' downhill. The 'fingers' are short and ending in blunt, hoof-like tips.
material: Matte, toasted-almond bone. Rough and pitted.
inset_view: Top-right corner: Cross-section showing dense bone built to hold the front half of the body low to the ground.
